final: SELECT d.name, t.date_of_treatment, b.breed_name FROM Dogs d JOIN Breeds b ON d.breed_code = b.breed_code LEFT JOIN Treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id WHERE d.breed_code IN (SELECT breed_code FROM Dogs GROUP BY breed_code HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM Dogs GROUP BY breed_code))) ORDER BY b.breed_name, d.name, t.date_of_treatment
